title: The National Academy of Sciences, U.S.A.
notes: Nature 107, 539-540 (23 June 1921), news report on the National Academy of Sciences annual meeting of April 25-27, 1921. Registered as a single-record entry (nature-1921-nas-report, owner decision 2026-10-10). Plain fetches reach the page only through nature.com's cookie redirect (?error=cookies_not_supported), which fetch_snapshot.py refuses as another record, so the snapshot is manual: the page's visible text (title, citation, public abstract) copied from the HTML fetched on 2026-10-10 with a cookie jar; the full text is subscription content and was not read. Needs the adversary's live check.

notes: Washington 1921 room, after the owner-approved Nature entry (2026-10-10). Two holders, each covering the whole claim: Nature 107:539 (registered single-record entry, institutional) and the Library of Congress Evening Star page of April 25, 1921 (secondary).
